smoke.notes: 4 embedded script blocks extracted (4832/12981/21103/1988 bytes); largest parses clean under node --check. essence: the account's public face: brand, positioning map, QA manifesto — running cells instead of screenshots

ideas.name: proof-by-running
ideas.statement: The front door asks for nothing: the four sheets are literally alive before you scroll, consoles stream real engine events, and 'the receipts are the story' — every other spreadsheet company ships screenshots and asks for trust.

ideas.name: the honest map
ideas.statement: Scored on the four things SuperInstance is actually about — not a claim of superiority everywhere, a claim of a different point on the map — with a plainly-worded panel of where Excel/Sheets/Airtable/Notion/Observable/Bloomberg/Hex still win today.

ideas.name: brand bound to meaning
ideas.statement: The 'deep tide' system binds every accent to a meaning (tide=life, signal=events, budget=economy, quantum=the quantum layer), never decoration: one glow per element, never rainbow, and the wordmark is a system font stack because self-containment is a feature.

ideas.name: playtest receipts are the story
ideas.statement: Four QA rounds each caught something real (ocean blew up to -7.2e+34, reversi never moved, hold'em shape froze at n=0, consoles unreadable, ocean looked dead), and the fixes are published next to the findings — iterating in public is the manifesto.

ideas.name: learning is visible and replayable
ideas.statement: Weights live in cells you can watch drift (reversi's loser re-weights after every game), a deterministic PRNG makes every reload replay honestly, and the page books its own provenance: 187 green checks, 12 engine patches, 36/36 upstream tests kept.

ideas.name: perception costs something
ideas.statement: In cards, in markets, in mines the odds are mechanical (pot odds cost 0 tokens — a formula) but judgment is metered: a signal is only a proposal, a confirmation cell is the gate, and entries can require a draw from a rationed quantum budget.

parts.name: single self-contained HTML substrate
parts.essence: One file, zero dependencies, works offline — the entire showcase (engine, four demos, landscape, manifesto, og assets) ships as index.html.
outputs: a running page with four live sheets
parts.failure_mode: any external dependency would break the offline promise
parts.evidence: index.html (1452 lines, 467KB incl. inline base64 art); README.md 'One file, zero dependencies, works offline'

parts.name: deep-tide token palette
parts.essence: CSS custom properties --ink/--surface/--tide/--signal/--budget/--quantum define the entire visual substrate; accents are semantic, not stylistic.
outputs: every surface, flash, meter and glow on the page
parts.failure_mode: a color used decoratively breaks the meaning-binding rule
parts.evidence: index.html lines 12-19 (:root tokens); brand/README.md 'Palette — deep tide'

parts.name: mini engine Sheet (value/formula/deps)
parts.essence: A ~120-line reactive engine embedded in the page: cell(id,value), def(id,deps,fn) with stale recompute, sameV deep-equality to suppress no-op cascades, errors captured as {__error}.
inputs: cell definitions from the four demo sheets
outputs: cell values recomputed only when dependencies change
parts.gate: formula re-eval is skipped when sameV(old,new) is true
parts.failure_mode: deep mutation aliasing silently skips recompute (the hold'em n=0 freeze bug)
parts.evidence: index.html lines 648-684 (class Sheet, _eval, _set, sameV); README 'same semantics as the full quilt runtime'

parts.name: Bus + watch listeners
parts.essence: A global Bus.emit fires on every value change; watch(target,fn) registers listeners; every mini-console in the page subscribes to real engine traffic.
outputs: listener actions: tide gauge lights foam, moves played, reads spoken
parts.gate: every console line must originate from a real Bus emit, not synthesized text
parts.failure_mode: theater consoles (scripted logs) would void the proof-by-running claim
parts.evidence: index.html lines 632-637 (Bus), 666 (watch), 683 (_set emits); demos intro 'real engine traffic, sampled, not theater'

parts.name: cascade cycle-guard
parts.essence: The Sheet carries depth and dead flags so a cascade cannot re-enter itself infinitely; listeners firing mid-cascade are the documented hazard it guards.
parts.gate: cascade depth bounded; dead sheet halts further _set propagation
parts.failure_mode: unbounded listener->set->listener loops (the class of bug that blew up the ocean)
parts.evidence: index.html line 651 (this.depth/this.dead), 684 (if (this.dead) return); README '~120-line reactive engine ... cascade cycle-guard'

parts.name: deterministic PRNG replay
parts.essence: Demos seed a deterministic PRNG 'so every reload replays honestly' — a reload is a re-run, not a new experiment.
parts.gate: reload N and reload N+1 must produce identical cell histories
parts.failure_mode: Math.random() would make screenshots unreproducible and QA flaky
parts.evidence: index.html line 708 comment 'deterministic PRNG so every reload replays honestly'

parts.name: visible weight drift (reversi loop)
parts.essence: TIDE (positional weights) vs TERRA (mobility) self-play reversi where the loser's weight cells drift after every game — the learning loop is watchable, not claimed.
parts.failure_mode: weights updated in a hidden store would reduce the demo to theater
parts.evidence: README.md demo table row 02; index.html demo-02 section

parts.name: gated entries on a rationed quantum budget
parts.essence: On the signal desk a signal is only a proposal; a confirmation cell is the gate; entries can require a draw from a rationed (mocked) quantum budget.
outputs: entry only on confirmation + budget draw
parts.gate: entry admitted only after confirmation cell AND quantum budget draw
parts.failure_mode: auto-entering on raw signal would contradict 'perception costs something'
parts.evidence: README.md demo table row 04; index.html demo-04 section

parts.name: honest-landscape policy
parts.essence: The comparison table is scored only on the four axes SuperInstance is actually about, and the page must carry a plainly-worded panel of where the big players win today — a bounded claim, never universal superiority.
inputs: competitor capabilities (Excel+Copilot, Sheets+Gemini, Airtable, Notion, Observable, Bloomberg, Hex/Deepnote)
outputs: yes/part/no scores per axis + 'where the big players win' panel
parts.gate: the honest panel must exist and name concrete domains where competitors win
parts.failure_mode: dropping the honest panel turns positioning into marketing

parts.name: accent discipline
parts.essence: Aqua leads; coral/amber/violet appear only where their meaning applies (events, economy, quantum); one glow per element, never rainbow — motion rules included ('nothing bounces; the tide moves').
outputs: colored element whose color encodes its meaning
parts.failure_mode: decorative color erodes the semantic palette

parts.name: offline brand constraint
parts.essence: The wordmark is intentionally a system font stack — the brand must render inside one self-contained HTML file with zero font downloads; the constraint is stated as a feature.
parts.failure_mode: a webfont dependency would silently break the self-containment law
parts.evidence: brand/README.md 'The wordmark is intentionally set in a system font stack'

parts.name: four live demos as the argument
parts.essence: Ocean-as-a-Sheet (336 value cells, wave formula, tide gauge), self-playing Reversi, Hold'em reading the players, and the signal desk — each demo is one claim tested in a realm.
outputs: four running sheets a stranger can watch
parts.failure_mode: any demo degrading to a canned animation
parts.evidence: README.md demo table; index.html demos section (DEMO 01-04)

parts.name: landscape table + positioning 2x2 SVG
parts.essence: The honest map is rendered twice: a scored HTML table and a standalone 2x2 SVG (static-to-living x human-driven-to-agentic) plotting all players with SuperInstance alone in the living+agentic quadrant.
parts.failure_mode: a map without the table's scores would be an unargued picture
parts.evidence: index.html lines 515-574 (svg viewBox 780x430, role=img aria-label 'Positioning map')

parts.name: the watching cell brand kit
parts.essence: mark.svg = a quilt of four cells, three quiet, one lit and pulsing — 'the smallest honest diagram of the whole idea'; logo lockup + 64px favicon + og-card.
parts.failure_mode: a logo the demos could not explain would be decoration

parts.name: playtest findings-to-fixes ledger
parts.essence: The README publishes the four QA rounds as a finding->fix table: wrong two-step wave scheme (-7.2e+34), pre-listener evaluation stall, copy-then-mutate aliasing fix, flex-shrink squash, render-gain revival.
outputs: public ledger of caught bugs and their fixes
parts.gate: every fix in the table must be traceable to a stated finding
parts.failure_mode: publishing fixes without findings launders the process
parts.evidence: README.md 'Playtest log — what iterating actually caught' (v1/v2/v3 table)

parts.name: automated screenshot evidence
parts.essence: demo-*.png and qa-*.png are real screenshots captured by the automated playtest, not mockups — the image directory is a receipt archive.
parts.gate: screenshots must come from real QA runs of the shipped file
parts.evidence: README.md images section; images/ (demo-ocean.png, qa-manifesto.png, qa-ecosystem.png, ...)

parts.name: live stats receipts
parts.essence: Hero stats book the engagement's provenance: 6 living projects, 187 green checks, 12 engine patches, 36/36 upstream tests kept — mirrored in the footer with a date.
outputs: on-page counters (hero + footer '187 checks green · 12 patches · 2026-09-25')
parts.failure_mode: stale counters would misstate the account's state

parts.name: zero-error console bar
parts.essence: Final QA state is 'zero console/page errors' with the hero canvas verified animating, reversi self-playing to 63 discs, hold'em reads climbing street by street — the acceptance receipt of the whole page.
outputs: a page whose console is clean
parts.gate: zero console/page errors across the whole playthrough
parts.failure_mode: any uncaught page error voids proof-by-running

parts.name: mechanical-vs-strategic split
parts.essence: Pot odds cost 0 tokens (a formula); opponent reads (shape.opp looseness/aggression/deception) are observations spoken by a listener, with a focus slider that fades your own cards into the environment.
outputs: free mechanical odds + metered observational reads
parts.gate: mechanical computation must remain free (0 tokens)
parts.failure_mode: charging tokens for arithmetic would collapse the economy metaphor
parts.evidence: README.md demo table row 03 ('the odds are mechanical; the players are the game')

layer_logic.0: substrate = one offline HTML file + a semantic token palette; the page cannot fall back on servers, fonts or frameworks
layer_logic.1: mechanism = a ~120-line reactive engine (value/formula/listener/bus + cycle-guard + deterministic PRNG) with the same semantics as the full quilt runtime
layer_logic.2: policy = honesty rules: score only what you are about and state where giants win; accents mean things; mechanical math is free, perception is metered
layer_logic.3: interface = four live demos, the landscape table + 2x2 map, and the watching-cell brand kit — everything a stranger touches
layer_logic.4: evidence = the playtest finding->fix ledger, automated screenshots, live counters, and a zero-error console bar as acceptance receipt
